title: Representation Complexity Along Learning Trajectories: Trading Width for Precision and Time
summary: The proof establishes a width/discovery gap for sparse parity under stated oracle and resolution assumptions; experiments examine dimension dependence and trajectory behavior. Formal theorem/proof and sparse-parity experiments support a theoretical result under explicit oracle, smoothness and resolution assumptions, not a universal empirical law.
